public_spec_source: 彼岸更新版.pdf, page 8, basic power laws / integrals / gradients; no fixed force formula or exponent list supplied
scope: Repair current-session state/probe-property symbolic search, output delivery and opt-in tool guidance. No simulator/truth imports or per-world formula templates. Body-position features remain out of scope.
stages: Unit and service tests including variable real powers, initial-domain failures, parameter-budget selection, complete executable argument delivery, and disabled-baseline prompt equivalence
Offline replay on the three original E7 search inputs; same acquired probes only, fixed 30/30/40-second budgets. Original heldout observations are diagnostic-only; do not change any previous score.
One new six-world autonomous Qwen3.8-27B batch, 4 identical model endpoints where available, one active mission per endpoint, no world retries or best-of selection.
recording: all raw axis candidates and explicit rejection reasons in current-session symbolic_search records
per-experiment exploration/evaluation/total seconds and average/maximum output tokens
actual SR calls, candidate valid-domain/short-rollout checks, candidate-to-fit/submit adoption
original scores and evaluation completeness separately
limitations: One six-world repair acceptance batch is not a controlled estimate of improvement or evidence of nine-hidden-world generalization; deterministic warm candidates carry their own provenance.
user_operator_clarification: Trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic operations are also possible. Keep the complete operator space, including real powers; prefer simple candidates without banning these functions.
